title: Matched native-harness real-SWAP versus Dummy-SWAP first-window response
purpose: Compare the first recharge transaction of the native-registry analytic Dummy-SWAP participant with real SWAP at the same 50x1 topology, MODFLOW strip, initial head, forcing and coupling service. Identify whether the first failure occurs in the shared application/MODFLOW path or in the real SWAP corrector transaction.

topology_and_parameters.drain: left MODFLOW DRN; no-flow right and bottom

trajectory.initial_state: C2A C1 matched-head real-SWAP state; the accepted C2a transaction is committed before the rain window, preserving SWAP temporal history

record: committed profile state hash before and after rejected window
gates_and_diagnostics.failure_classification: A corrector rejection before publication, with unchanged committed profile/revisions/ledgers and no MODFLOW finalization, is assigned to the real-SWAP participant-side transaction for this trajectory; it does not by itself identify an individual Richards equation or prove all coupling paths correct.

replay: Repeat both tolerance cases in independent fresh processes. Results must be byte-identical within each deterministic real-SWAP case.
out_of_scope: changing canonical coupling semantics or production tolerances

authorization.authorized_by: user instruction in active Work session
authorization.scope: Local research-only experiment and persisted evidence; no production behavior change.
